priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the target.
Trinket Usage Stat-granting on-use Trinkets should be used right before Bestial Wrath.
Use all Barbed Shots right before Bestial Wrath comes off cooldown.
If Bestial Wrath is coming up within a few seconds, hold a Kill Command charge for it.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler.
Cast Kill Command if you have 2 charges
Cast Kill Command if Bestial Wrath is active
Cast Barbed Shot if you have 2 charges
